ingredients.name: Canola / rapeseed oil
ingredients.reason: Canola oil is an industrial seed oil. Mindset rules avoid seed oils; this is a Mindset preference, not a safety finding.

ingredients.name: Soybean oil
ingredients.reason: Soybean oil is an industrial seed oil. Mindset rules avoid seed oils; this is a Mindset preference, not a safety finding.

ingredients.name: Corn oil
ingredients.reason: Corn oil is an industrial seed oil. Mindset rules avoid seed oils; this is a Mindset preference, not a safety finding.

ingredients.name: Cottonseed oil
ingredients.reason: Cottonseed oil is an industrial seed oil. Mindset rules avoid seed oils; this is a Mindset preference, not a safety finding.

ingredients.name: Sunflower / safflower oil
ingredients.reason: Sunflower and safflower oils are industrial seed oils. Mindset rules avoid seed oils; this is a Mindset preference, not a safety finding.

ingredients.name: High-oleic sunflower / safflower oil
ingredients.reason: High-oleic oils are bred to contain mostly monounsaturated fat. Mindset rules treat them as borderline, and you can allow them in Rules.

ingredients.name: Grapeseed / rice bran oil
ingredients.reason: Grapeseed and rice bran oils are industrial seed oils. Mindset rules avoid seed oils; this is a Mindset preference, not a safety finding.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil (unspecified)
ingredients.reason: "Vegetable oil" doesn't say which oil is used, and it is often a seed oil. Mindset rules treat it as borderline.

ingredients.name: Partially hydrogenated oil
ingredients.reason: Partially hydrogenated oils are the main source of artificial trans fat. The US FDA no longer recognises them as safe for use in food.

ingredients.name: Palm oil
ingredients.reason: Palm oil is a refined tropical fat. Mindset rules treat it as borderline.

ingredients.name: Avocado oil
ingredients.reason: Avocado oil is pressed from the fruit. Mindset rules highlight it as a preferred fat.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.reason: Olive oil is pressed from the fruit. Mindset rules highlight it as a preferred fat.

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.reason: Coconut oil is pressed from the fruit. Mindset rules highlight it as a preferred fat.

ingredients.name: Butter / ghee / tallow
ingredients.reason: Butter, ghee and tallow are traditional animal fats. Mindset rules highlight them as preferred fats.

ingredients.name: Red 40
ingredients.reason: Red 40 is a synthetic dye. The EU requires a warning label on foods that contain it.

ingredients.name: Yellow 5 (tartrazine)
ingredients.reason: Tartrazine (Yellow 5) is a synthetic dye. The EU requires a warning label on foods that contain it.

ingredients.name: Yellow 6 (sunset yellow)
ingredients.reason: Sunset yellow (Yellow 6) is a synthetic dye. The EU requires a warning label on foods that contain it.

ingredients.name: Blue 1 / Blue 2
ingredients.reason: Brilliant blue (Blue 1) and indigo carmine (Blue 2) are synthetic dyes. Mindset rules avoid synthetic dyes.

ingredients.name: Red 3 (erythrosine)
ingredients.reason: Erythrosine (Red 3) is a synthetic dye. In January 2025 the US FDA revoked its authorisation for use in food, effective 2027.

ingredients.name: Titanium dioxide
ingredients.reason: Titanium dioxide is a white colouring. The EU stopped authorising it as a food additive in 2022.

ingredients.name: Caramel colour
ingredients.reason: Caramel colour is a processed colouring, often made with ammonia or sulphites (E150c, E150d). Mindset rules treat it as borderline.

ingredients.name: High-fructose corn syrup
ingredients.reason: High-fructose corn syrup is a refined sweetener made from corn starch. Mindset rules avoid it.

ingredients.name: Added sugar
ingredients.reason: This is an added sugar. Mindset rules treat added sugars as borderline, and strict mode treats them as not approved.

ingredients.name: Aspartame
ingredients.reason: Aspartame is an artificial sweetener. Mindset rules avoid artificial sweeteners.

ingredients.name: Sucralose
ingredients.reason: Sucralose is an artificial sweetener. Mindset rules avoid artificial sweeteners.

ingredients.name: Acesulfame K
ingredients.reason: Acesulfame K is an artificial sweetener. Mindset rules avoid artificial sweeteners.

ingredients.name: Saccharin
ingredients.reason: Saccharin is an artificial sweetener. Mindset rules avoid artificial sweeteners.

ingredients.name: Artificial flavours
ingredients.reason: Artificial flavours are made synthetically. Mindset rules avoid them.

ingredients.name: Natural flavours
ingredients.reason: "Natural flavours" can cover many substances, and the label doesn't say which. Mindset rules treat them as borderline.

ingredients.name: BHA / BHT / TBHQ
ingredients.reason: BHA, BHT and TBHQ are synthetic antioxidant preservatives. Mindset rules avoid them.

ingredients.name: Sodium nitrite / nitrate
ingredients.reason: Nitrites and nitrates are curing salts used in processed meats. Mindset rules avoid them.

ingredients.name: Sodium benzoate
ingredients.reason: Sodium benzoate is a synthetic preservative. Mindset rules treat it as borderline.

ingredients.name: MSG
ingredients.reason: MSG (monosodium glutamate) is a flavour enhancer. Mindset rules treat it as borderline.

ingredients.name: Carrageenan
ingredients.reason: Carrageenan is a seaweed-derived thickener. Mindset rules treat it as borderline.

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 80
ingredients.reason: Polysorbate 80 is a synthetic emulsifier. Mindset rules treat it as borderline.

ingredients.name: Gelatin
ingredients.reason: Gelatin is made from animal collagen. Turn on "No gelatin" in Rules to treat it as not approved.

ingredients.name: Gums
ingredients.reason: Gums are thickeners, mostly from plants or fermentation. They're fine under standard rules; strict mode treats them as borderline.

ingredients.name: Common additives
ingredients.reason: A common food additive. Mindset rules don’t flag it.

ingredients.name: Mono- and diglycerides and other emulsifiers
ingredients.reason: Processed emulsifiers made from fats. Mindset rules don’t flag them by default.

ingredients.name: Sorbates, propionates and sulphites
ingredients.reason: Common preservatives. Mindset rules don’t flag them by default.

ingredients.name: Calcium disodium EDTA
ingredients.reason: A synthetic sequestrant that keeps colour and flavour stable. Mindset rules don’t flag it by default.

ingredients.name: Disodium inosinate / guanylate (ribonucleotides)
ingredients.reason: Flavour enhancers usually used alongside MSG. Mindset rules treat them like MSG: borderline.

ingredients.name: Stevia and sugar alcohols
ingredients.reason: Plant-derived sweeteners (stevia, monk fruit) and sugar alcohols. Mindset rules don’t flag them by default.

ingredients.name: Shea and other tropical fats
ingredients.reason: Refined tropical fats used like palm oil. Mindset rules treat them as borderline, like palm oil.

ingredients.name: Peanut (groundnut) oil
ingredients.reason: Peanut oil is a refined legume oil, high in omega-6 fats like seed oils. Mindset rules treat it as borderline; this is a Mindset preference.

ingredients.name: Quinoline yellow
ingredients.reason: Quinoline yellow is a synthetic dye. The EU requires a warning label on foods that contain it.

ingredients.name: Carmoisine (azorubine)
ingredients.reason: Carmoisine is a synthetic dye. The EU requires a warning label on foods that contain it.

ingredients.name: Ponceau 4R
ingredients.reason: Ponceau 4R is a synthetic dye. The EU requires a warning label on foods that contain it.
